name: Create Status
description: Creates a status to the given workspace. [See the documentation](https://developers.podio.com/doc/status/add-new-status-message-22336)

configurable_props.name: alertInvite
configurable_props.label: Alert Invite
configurable_props.description: True if any mentioned user should be automatically invited to the workspace if the user does not have access to the object and access cannot be granted to the object. Default value: `false`

configurable_props.name: embedId
configurable_props.label: Embed ID
configurable_props.description: The id of an embedded link that has been created with the Add an embed operation in the Embed area

configurable_props.name: question
configurable_props.label: Question
configurable_props.description: Any question to be attached. Must be a valid JSON object, e.g. `{"text": "Some Question?","options": ["option1", "option2",...]}`
